skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Tidal Bore
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tidal Bore. Clothes Lucilla wore when looking around an exhibit about extinct marine species. The eye is led down the outfit by the changes in color mimicking seawater at different depths, punctuated by unique patterns to form a calm, tranquil ensemble.
skins.quote: Lucilla hypothesizes that there are yet more marine species out there that are being driven to extinction by the Seaborn, but she does not have the leisure to grieve for them for long. She tries to dig up more information, all the better to make traps for capturing Seaborn. She's already got plenty of new ideas.
